seoTitle: The O.C. Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The O.C. test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Ryan, Seth, Marissa, Summer, Sandy, Kirsten, Julie or Taylor — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the brooding outsider, the lovable nerd, or the social climber with a secret? Answer 12 everyday questions about friendship, family and fitting in, and find out which character from The O.C. you are.

characters.name: Ryan Atwood
characters.title: The Outsider
characters.summary: Quiet, tough and fiercely protective. You don't say much, but you'll always have someone's back.
description: Like Ryan, you've had to be tough. He's a troubled kid from Chino who gets taken in by the Cohens in Newport Beach.
You protect people. When someone Ryan cares about is in trouble, his first instinct is to step in, with his fists if he has to.
You beat the odds. Ryan finishes high school and goes on to university, a long way from where he started.
characters.flaw: You'd rather brood in silence than tell anyone what's wrong.
characters.signature: A white vest, a furrowed brow and a punch you'd rather not throw.
characters.clashReason: they'd go quiet and brood instead of talking

characters.name: Seth Cohen
characters.title: The Lovable Nerd
characters.summary: Funny, awkward and full of opinions. You talk too much, and that's part of your charm.
description: Like Seth, you're the quick-witted one. Sandy and Kirsten's son is awkward, funny and full of pop-culture references.
You love what you love. Seth is obsessed with comic books, and he isn't embarrassed about it.
You play the long game in love. Seth had a crush on Summer from third grade, and the show ends with their wedding.
characters.flaw: You overthink and overtalk everything, especially when it matters.
characters.signature: A comic book, a sarcastic comeback and a crush you've had since third grade.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every serious talk into a joke

characters.name: Marissa Cooper
characters.title: The Troubled Heart
characters.summary: Beautiful, loyal and always on the edge of something. You feel everything, and you're drawn to trouble.
description: Like Marissa, you're the one everyone notices. She's Summer's best friend, and the girl next door Ryan falls for.
You're drawn to the edge. Marissa struggles with drink and drugs, and her relationships are often turbulent.
Your story is a bittersweet one. Marissa's ends in tragedy, in the season three finale.
characters.flaw: You run towards danger when you should be running away from it.
characters.signature: A pretty dress, a sad song and a lot of drama.
characters.clashReason: they'd drag you into their latest crisis

characters.name: Summer Roberts
characters.title: The Firecracker
characters.summary: Fierce, funny and fiercely loyal. You've got a temper, and a much bigger heart than you let on.
description: Like Summer, you're tougher than you look. She starts out as one of Newport's sharpest-tongued gossips.
You don't hold back. Summer is outspoken, and her temper is legendary.
You grow into yourself. Summer becomes more thoughtful, starts caring deeply about the environment, and marries Seth in the end.
characters.flaw: Your temper goes from zero to a hundred in seconds.
characters.signature: A designer bag, a cutting comeback and a soft spot for a nerd.
characters.clashReason: they'd lose their temper at you over nothing

characters.name: Sandy Cohen
characters.title: The Idealist
characters.summary: Warm, principled and always fighting for the underdog. You believe everyone deserves a chance.
description: Like Sandy, you see the best in people. He's an idealistic public defender who took Ryan in when nobody else would.
You stick to your principles. Sandy is a left-leaning guy from the Bronx who never quite fits in with Newport's rich crowd.
You're the heart of your family. Sandy holds the Cohens together with warmth and good advice.
characters.flaw: You take on everyone else's problems, even when your own family needs you.
characters.signature: A surfboard, a briefcase and a spare room for whoever needs it.
characters.clashReason: they'd take in every lost cause they met

characters.name: Kirsten Cohen
characters.title: The Composed One
characters.summary: Calm, capable and quietly strong. You hold it together for everyone, even when it's hard.
description: Like Kirsten, you're the sensible one. She's Sandy's wife and Seth's mum, and she was once the CFO of her father's company.
You're more careful than the people around you. Kirsten is more conservative than Sandy, and she thinks before she leaps.
You carry more than you show. Kirsten privately struggled with alcohol, and she faced it head on.
characters.flaw: You keep your struggles so private that nobody knows to help.
characters.signature: A crisp blazer, a calm voice and a plan for everything.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay perfectly calm while you're falling apart

characters.name: Julie Cooper
characters.title: The Social Climber
characters.summary: Glamorous, scheming and always one step ahead. You know what you want, and you go and get it.
description: Like Julie, you know how the world works. She's Marissa's mum, and she's always looking for her next step up.
You put yourself first. Julie can be devious, selfish and shallow, and all of Newport knows it.
But you're a survivor. Underneath it all, Julie has a vulnerable side, and by the end she's turned her life around and finished college.
characters.flaw: You'd use anyone to get ahead, even the people you love.
characters.signature: Designer heels, a rich new husband and a secret or three.
characters.clashReason: they'd use you to climb, then forget your name

characters.name: Taylor Townsend
characters.title: The Overachiever
characters.summary: Intense, ambitious and completely extra. You want to be the best at everything, and you're not shy about it.
description: Like Taylor, you go all in. She's a neurotic perfectionist who throws herself into everything she does.
You're intense, and you know it. Taylor starts out as a rival to the gang before becoming one of them.
You find your people in the end. Taylor's surprising connection with Ryan is one of the best things about the final season.
characters.flaw: You try so hard that you wear everyone out, including yourself.
characters.signature: A clipboard, a sign-up sheet and far too much enthusiasm.
characters.clashReason: they'd sign you up for everything without asking

questions.text: You get dragged to a charity gala full of rich people you don't know. You...

options.text: Find someone else who hates this too, and hide in the kitchen cracking jokes
Talk far too much to the first person who looks friendly
Work the room. Everyone here could be useful
Introduce yourself to everyone, with a fun fact you prepared earlier

questions.text: Your partner completely forgets your anniversary. You...

options.text: Lose it. Loudly. Then let them make it up to you
Realise you forgot too, and panic-plan something at the last minute
Mention it calmly, and let them feel bad on their own
Decide it's a sign, and start wondering if this is even working

questions.text: Someone you barely know needs somewhere to stay. You...

options.text: Offer them your spare room. Everyone deserves a chance
Say yes, but quietly lock away the valuables
Absolutely not. What would the neighbours think?
Help them out. You know exactly how that feels

questions.text: You're stuck in a really boring class. You...

options.text: Draw a comic strip in the margins
Ask fourteen questions and volunteer for extra credit
Text your best friend a running commentary
Stare out of the window and wish you were anywhere else

questions.text: Someone is picking on a friend of yours. You...

options.text: Step in. If it turns into a fight, so be it
Tell them off so viciously they never try it again
Make a sarcastic comment from a safe distance
Calmly explain exactly why they're in the wrong

questions.text: You're offered money to do something a bit shady. You...

options.text: Take it. You have to look out for yourself
Refuse. Some things aren't for sale
Do it, then regret it immediately
Read the small print, then say no

questions.text: You're going through a rough patch. You...

options.text: Run away from it, as far as you can
Keep it to yourself and brood
Hold it together in public, and fall apart in private
Go surfing at dawn until your head is clear

questions.text: You've got a big project due. You...

options.text: Finish it weeks early, then do an extra one for fun
Leave it until the night before, then pull an all-nighter on snacks alone
Make a plan, stick to it, done
Quietly build the whole thing yourself, and it turns out brilliant

questions.text: Your mum or dad embarrasses you in front of your friends. You...

options.text: Storm out and slam the door
Roll your eyes so hard it hurts
Apologise to everyone on their behalf
Shrug. You've seen far worse

questions.text: You want to get to know someone you like. You...

options.text: Ramble nervously, make an obscure joke, and hope for the best
Pretend you can't stand them for as long as possible
Find out what they're worth first
Make a plan with a timeline, and follow it to the letter

questions.text: You're a teenager from a rough town, and a rich family takes you in. You...

options.text: Wait for it all to go wrong. It always does
See exactly how far this can take you
Fall for the one person here who seems just as lost
Make it very clear you're not impressed by their money

questions.text: You live in a gated community where everyone has a secret. You...

options.text: Collect everyone's secrets and use them when you need to
Stand up for the people who don't have anyone on their side
Keep the peace, keep your own secrets and keep your head up
Run for the social committee and fix everything yourself
